issues.detail: Hebrew says Sennacherib sent his servants to Jerusalem while he himself was at Lachish (וְהוּא עַל לָכִישׁ). The Chinese renders '從拉吉城門' (from the gate of Lachish), which changes the meaning: it implies the servants were sent from Lachish, whereas the Hebrew states Sennacherib was at Lachish (with all his forces) while sending servants to Jerusalem. This alters the spatial relationship and who is where.
